title: Chinese Orange Pudding Toast
description: A sweet and refreshing dessert inspired by Chinese flavors, made with orange, bread, and a hint of zesty orange.
instructions: Cut the bread into 1-inch cubes and toast until lightly browned.
Peel the orange and separate the segments.
In a blender or food processor, puree the orange segments until smooth.
Add the orange zest and blend until well combined.
In a separate bowl, mix the pudding with the orange puree until well combined.
Dip each toasted bread cube into the pudding mixture, coating completely.
